$comment: Merge into <workspace>/.claude/settings.json — do not overwrite an existing file; append the hooks and permissions. The three SessionStart hooks: regenerate the board, run drift quietly, warn if a child project is unlinked.

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.sdd-workspace/scripts/link-workspace.mjs" --check 2>/dev/null || echo "  ⚠︎ Projects unlinked from the workspace. Run /sdd-workspace-link"
